messages:
maria: Heads-up, ran a shadow benchmark against latest mixer branch and saw a weird regress on mixtral/llama combos with RoPE scale >1.0.
aj: Can you paste numbers? latency/p99 or throughput?
maria: p50 ~2% up, p95 ~12% up for long-context (8k tokens). Throughput drops ~18% under 32-batch steady load. raw profile attached below.
maria: ```
Model: mixtral-8B (rotary_scale=1.2)
Backend: cuda-rt
Kernel: default-fused-attn
Batch: 32, seq=8192
p50: 84ms -> 86ms
p95: 210ms -> 235ms
throughput tok/s: 120k -> 98k
CPU: small increase on main thread
KV mem writes: +22%
```
cheng-ml: Interesting. Does this correlate with KV cache eviction or just attention kernel switch? Any kernel fallback logs?
maria: Kernel selector flipped from optimized-fmha to fallback-rope-stable for many sequences after the rope-scale param was parsed during HF config parse. We log kernel choices per request in debug.
sophie-sre: Could this be batching heuristic choosing smaller micro-batches because of increased memory usage per request? We saw batch sizing drop to 28 on some hosts.
aj: I suspect two interacting things: (1) kernel selector uses head/kv_dim heuristics that assume rope_scale==1; with >1 it marks as 'nonstandard' and disables some fused paths. (2) that triggers higher KV writes which pushes eviction policy earlier and causes batching to fragment.
maria: Reproduced in a small harness: toggling rotary_scale back to 1.0 restores previous kernel and performance. Patch that parses rotary_scale differently (treat as float config only) made selector choose optimized-fmha again.
cheng-ml: Can you share the minimal repro command?
maria: ```bash
# repro harness
python -m bench.runtime --model mixtral-8b --hf-config ./configs/mixtral-8b-rotary.json --batch 32 --seq 8192 --profile
``` 
aj: Two proposals:
- Short: relax kernel-selector strictness so it's tolerant to rotary_scale!=1 when architecture matches known patterns.
- Medium: add a kernel feature probe at model load time (run tiny token pass to probe kernel compatibility) and cache result per model-version.
sophie-sre: Medium sounds safer. Short change could reintroduce other subtle numerical issues.
maria: Agreed. Also KV eviction heuristics: when kernel falls back, KV write amplification increases; current eviction threshold is static percent of GPU mem. Suggest adaptive-threshold: if per-request KV writes/spill > X then degrade batching target.
aj: We need concrete metrics to trigger adaptive-threshold. Let's track per-request kv_bytes_written and kv_evictions in metrics pipeline.
cheng-ml: Add a probe: run 64-step generation locally with random prompt length distribution and count kv write bytes. If > 20% increase vs baseline, mark model as 'high-kv-write' and set conservative batch target.
maria: I'll add the probe and a kernel-probe. Plan:
1) model-load kernel probe (single-token pass) -> record kernel id
2) microbench (64 steps) -> record kv_bytes, per-token latency
3) emit model metadata tag: kernel_probe_result, kv_write_profile
4) runtime kernel selector consults model metadata first

aj: Sounds good. Who owns implementation?
maria: I'll take model-load probe and kernel-selector change.
cheng-ml: I'll add microbench kv profiler and a flag in model metadata store.
sophie-sre: I'll wire up dashboards for kv_bytes_written, kv_evictions, batch_size, kernel_choice to alert on regressions (threshold p95 increase >10%).
deploy-bot: ci pipeline: run bench.runtime unit tests and microbench on PR; will block if perf regresses >5% on p95.
aj: For quick triage, can we add a runtime override env var to force kernel selection to 'optimized-fmha' for canary hosts? CHR_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=optimized-fmha
maria: Yes I'll add that + a canary rollout plan.
cheng-ml: Also found HF config parsing inconsistency: when rotary_scale present as string "1.2" vs float 1.2 we treat differently in parser and mark metadata as 'unknown-rotary'. I'll add normalization in hfparser.
aj: Good catch. That explains some of the config drift from older converters.
maria: I'll open a PR titled "runtime: kernel probe + kv microbench + hfparser rotary normalization" with experimental flag.
sophie-sre: Thx. Once PR is in, let's run shadowbench across the dedicated pool and monitor evictions + kernel_choice tag.
aj: Timeline? maria/cheng any ETA?
maria: PR by EOD, tests tomorrow, canary next Wed.
cheng-ml: I'll prepare the dashboard panels and alert rules today.
sophie-sre: Adding a runbook note: if we see p95 spike after rollout, rollback via CHR_KERNEL_OVERRIDE and disable canary.
aj: Nice. Also log the exact kernel switch stack traces for easier repro.
maria: Will include extra debug logs behind a config flag.
cheng-ml: One more: converter scripts (safetensors->our-weights) sometimes drop head count when metadata axes missing; that can change kv_dim — add a validator that compares hf_config['n_head'] vs weight.shape if present.
aj: Add that to conversion linter, block uploads that mismatch.
maria: Ok summary saved in internal ticket INF-4829. I'll paste link when created.
aj: Sweet. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
